body:
Confirmed parena build already accepts a .prn at any path -- no compiler change needed. New bazel/parena_compile.bzl (parena_compile_c), live-verified via a real bazel build (single-file + multi-file deps cases). Cites 2 existing precedents (DUNG, ladybug). README.md updated. Commit b2fa41f.

⚓ ☃
title: Reusable Bazel macro for co-located .prn adoption (PX-001/PX-BZ-001)
